description: A class for connecting to a YouTrack issue tracking instance, managing issues, users, projects, and custom fields via REST API.

classes.name: Connection
classes.description: Main class for connecting and interacting with YouTrack's REST API, offering methods for issue management, user management, project configuration, custom fields, and states.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new connection instance, setting URL and authenticating with provided login credentials.

methods.name: _clean_url_parameters
methods.description: Removes array entries with empty values from URL parameters.

methods.name: _login
methods.description: Performs login request to YouTrack and manages session cookies.

methods.name: _request
methods.description: Executes HTTP requests using cURL with specified method, URL, and optional body.

methods.name: _request_xml
methods.description: Executes HTTP request expecting XML response, returning parsed XML or raw content based on content type.

methods.name: _get
methods.description: Performs GET request and returns XML or raw content.

methods.name: _put
methods.description: Performs PUT request with empty XML body.

methods.name: get_issue
methods.description: Retrieves a specific issue by ID and returns an Issue object.

methods.name: create_issue
methods.description: Creates a new issue with provided details and returns an Issue object.

methods.name: get_comments
methods.description: Retrieves comments for a specified issue.

methods.name: get_attachments
methods.description: Retrieves attachments for a specified issue.

methods.name: get_attachment_content
methods.description: Downloads attachment content given its URL.

methods.name: get_links
methods.description: Retrieves linked issues for a given issue ID.

methods.name: get_user
methods.description: Retrieves user information for a given login.

methods.name: create_user
methods.description: Creates a user by importing user data.

methods.name: create_user_detailed
methods.description: Creates a user with detailed information such as login, full name, email, and jabber handle.

methods.name: import_users
methods.description: Imports a list of users into YouTrack.

methods.name: import_issues_xml
methods.description: Imports issues from an XML payload.

methods.name: import_links
methods.description: Imports link definitions between issues.

methods.name: import_issues
methods.description: Imports issues into a project.

methods.name: get_project
methods.description: Retrieves project information.

methods.name: get_project_assignee_groups

methods.name: get_group
methods.description: Retrieves group details by name.

methods.name: get_user_groups
methods.description: Gets groups associated with a user.

methods.name: set_user_group
methods.description: Assigns a user to a group.

methods.name: create_group
methods.description: Creates a new group.

methods.name: get_role
methods.description: Retrieves role details.

methods.name: get_subsystem
methods.description: Retrieves subsystem details for a project.

methods.name: get_subsystems
methods.description: Lists all subsystems for a project.

methods.name: get_versions
methods.description: Gets all versions for a project.

methods.name: get_version
methods.description: Retrieves a specific version.

methods.name: get_builds
methods.description: Lists builds for a project.

methods.name: get_users
methods.description: Searches for users based on query.

methods.name: create_build
methods.description: Placeholder for creating a build.

methods.description: Creates a project accessible via project object.
